notes.title: UI - Gamepad and Demo
notes.content:
Hi ya!

We've been busy with UI code and graphics + adding support for gamepads.

We have several different types of in-game User Interface in Anord.

-Informational UIs help with the lore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/0b0ee3e6b05098ea7d0e332837a1456128ed4472.gif[/img]

-Vendor and Loot UIs let use buy/sell items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/92f9e72a85beced6fc107805b47699bef9b09861.gif[/img]

-UI for Moving Platforms that have interaction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/38ad4814fc84460035b2e7d40e62830335bfd337.gif[/img]

-UI for Weapon Crafting is where you open weapon component slots and attach a dropped weapon to component to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/983cb9c41bbe5969a062d681a9b94a2f34843748.gif[/img]

- Upgrades UI is where you use your hard earned XP to power up your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37544798/04da6e6b00700dfed8ef1c443ce20d195a59a53f.gif[/img]

beside those we also have Inventory, Minimap and some smaller ones.

Gamepads are a thing now. It needs a bit more testing but it is in at the moment.

We want to release a demo in the coming month and get some feedback from everyone. Not to mention we're extremely excited about that!

See you all in the next announcement!

notes.title: Main Menu + New AI + Save System...
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Lots of things have changed:

[list]
[*] We added new options to the main menu for customization and for preparation for the "Input Customization".
[*] New AI is still going on. It has improved too much from the previous iteration. AI will be able use ladders and jump up/down if everything goes as planned.
[*] We started on the Save System as well. We are still considering if we should add "Save Slots" or not but other than that Player / Dialogue / Quest / Inventory can be saved at the moment. We still got some work on the Loading part though.
[*] We managed to do a project wide structural change which will let us testing and finding bugs faster.
[*] Lots and lots of bug fixes.
[*] We started our social networks for better communication. Made a huge face lift-up to Steam Store page.
[/list]

We're aiming to update the demo with all the new features. This will be huge for us.
There are so many things we'd like to show to you.

notes.title: New Features
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've added:

[list]
[*] [u]Ragdolls[/u]: AI now goes to ragdoll state when it is dead
[*] [u]AI death sequence[/u]: AI fades away smoothly after going ragdoll.
[*] [u]Player Upgrade UI[/u]: We can check Player level and inventory contains before upgrading an Ability.
[*] [u]Ability upgrade items[/u]: Certain items required to upgrade abilities.
[*] [u]Player Progression[/u]: Player gains XP on each kill and levels up after certain amount of XP.
[*] [u]Damage Popups[/u]: Damage amount and type(shield, critical, normal) is represented with numbers and color.
[*] [u]Weapon Upgrade UI[/u]: Player can add/remove Weapon components from this UI.
[/list]

Ragdoll:
